semantics.next_state: At each rising edge, Q <= r_in if L is 1; otherwise Q <= q_in.
semantics.latency: Selected input is reflected after the rising-edge nonblocking update; one register stage.
semantics.between_edges: Q holds its last sampled value; falling edges do not update Q.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior.
semantics.initialization: No specified initial value; no RTL initialization.
semantics.factoring: q_in supplies the externally computed recurrence bit; XOR and inter-flip-flop wiring belong outside this submodule.
semantics.sampling: Inputs are sampled at every rising edge, with no enable or handshake.

numeric.type: Single-bit logic for all ports and state
numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic in this submodule; only selection and storage.

verification.method: Independent self-checking testbench with expected sampled bit and case-inequality comparisons.
cases: All eight binary combinations of L, q_in and r_in, from both prior Q states
Input changes between rising edges must not change Q
Falling edge must not change Q
verification.initial_state: Do not require a defined initial Q; establish known state using a rising-edge load.
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; finite compile and simulation timeouts.
